notes: Evidence spans two checks: 5 October (0.1.78-3795b4c) and 8 October (0.1.78-636f3f5, which fixed #193: the bubble, slider semantics, JFSThemeProvider, testID, onChangeEnd on unchanged keys, ref methods while disabled). The Sources note gives the 5 October build (636f3f5), checked 8 October. The installed build is 0.1.78-c1fa197; Slider.tsx is unchanged between 636f3f5 and c1fa197 upstream. The Do/Don't caption "Three positions read better as Radios." names Radios; useInstead is Radio, though the package also exports RadioButton and the guide does not say which. The avoidWhen item on typed exact amounts rests on the evidence's report of the upstream Slider.mdx, not on the guide's own copy, so it has no useInstead. The package lists ten mode collections for Slider (AppearanceBrand, AppearanceSystem, Color Mode, Context, Emphasis, Page type, Semantic Intent, Text Appearance, Text Sizes, Weight); the guide and evidence do not say which change it, and the guide shows Light only. The two "only" conditions (hide the end labels only when the range is stated nearby; disable only while the value can't change) are marked ambiguous: they read as firm conditions, but the package cannot check them. Guide problem: the Sizing description says the bubble floats "about 40 px" above the Slider; the evidence measured 38 px above the Slider's top on 3795b4c and keeps a 48 px Room on 636f3f5, so the figure is approximate.

examples.purpose: A rupee amount from ₹500 to ₹50,000 that snaps to ₹500 steps.
examples.jsx:
<Slider
  accessibilityLabel="Monthly SIP amount"
  minValue={500}
  maxValue={50000}
  step={500}
  defaultValue={5000}
  formatOptions={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'INR', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }}
  locale="en-IN"
  onChange={(value) => {}}
  modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}
/>

from.quote: Values snap to ₹500 steps and read as rupees.

examples.purpose: A loan tenure whose format function also writes “1 year”.
examples.jsx:
<Slider
  accessibilityLabel="Loan tenure"
  minValue={1}
  maxValue={30}
  defaultValue={10}
  formatValue={(value) => (value === 1 ? '1 year' : `${value} years`)}
  modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}
/>

from.quote: A format function writes “10 years”; make it say “1 year” too.

  <Slider

evidenceFacts.name: alwaysShowTooltip
evidenceFacts.description: Either way the bubble sits 12 px above the 20 px handle row and takes no layout space, so content directly above the Slider is covered.
evidenceFacts.quote: The bubble is still positioned 12 px above the 20 px handle row and takes no layout space

evidenceFacts.name: formatOptions
evidenceFacts.description: Formats the bubble and both end labels, like formatValue.
evidenceFacts.quote: `formatValue` and `formatOptions` format the bubble and both end labels.

evidenceFacts.name: formatValue
evidenceFacts.description: Also formats the end labels, so a function that appends a unit must handle the singular: a plain `${v} years` writes “1 years” on the minimum label.
evidenceFacts.quote: also writes "1 years" on the minimum label, so the format function must handle singulars.

evidenceFacts.name: isDisabled
evidenceFacts.description: 50% opacity, tabindex -1, no drag or key response; on the web it also sets aria-disabled (636f3f5).
evidenceFacts.quote: Disabled: 50% opacity, `tabindex=-1`, no drag or key response.

evidenceFacts.name: accessibilityLabel
evidenceFacts.description: Names the role=slider element, the only element carrying the name; it exposes aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuetext, and aria-disabled when disabled.
evidenceFacts.quote: `role="slider"` with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and `aria-valuetext`, plus `aria-disabled` when disabled; only one element carries the name.

evidenceFacts.name: step
evidenceFacts.description: Arrow keys move one step, Page Up and Down 10% of the range, Home and End to the ends; tapping anywhere on the 20 px row jumps the handle there.
evidenceFacts.quote: Arrow keys move one step, Page Up/Down 10% of the range, Home/End to the ends; tapping anywhere on the 20 px row jumps the handle there.

evidenceFacts.name: onChangeEnd
evidenceFacts.description: Fires on release and on key presses; since 636f3f5 not when a key can't change the value. Ref methods do nothing while disabled.
evidenceFacts.quote: `onChangeEnd` no longer fires when a key can't change the value, and ref methods do nothing while disabled.

evidenceFacts.name: modes
evidenceFacts.description: Since 636f3f5, JFSThemeProvider's modes apply too, matching the modes prop.
